title.narrative: Sustainable Mine Action in Support of Conflict Affected Refugees, Internally Displaced People and Communities in the Democratic Republic of the Congo

description.narrative: Sustainable mine action in support of conflict affected refugees, internally displaced people and communities in the the Democratic Republic of the Congo. \nSince independence in 1960, the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has had several armed conflicts resulting in nationwide contamination by explosive hazards and illicit proliferation of small arms and light weapons. UNMAS MONUSCO has been present in the DRC since 2002 and currently has offices in Beni, Bukavu, Goma,Kalemie and Kinshasa, to coordinate and implement its country-wide activities in support of the Government of the DRC, MONUSCO and the UN Country Team.\nUNOPS provides support for UNMAS activities in over 18 countries and territories
